label: File List
description: Sortable list of items with drag-and-drop. Best for product files such as images, specs, video and audio, each row with a type icon, a colored badge and its size.

label: Grid Layout
description: Sortable list of items with grid layout. Best for asset cards with a title, a one line description and a colored type badge in an equal height 3 column layout, grips shown while pressed.

label: Nested Layout
description: Sortable list of items with nested layout. Best for option groups such as colors, sizes and materials reordered as cards, with each group's values reordered inside it.

label: Playlist
description: Sortable playlist with frame. Best for a music queue in a Frame with a track count, a Playing badge on the current song and the length of every track.

label: Settings Priority
description: Sortable settings priority with frame. Best for notification channels ranked by delivery order in a Frame, each row with a Switch that turns the channel on or off.

label: Sidebar Navigation
description: Sortable sidebar navigation with frame. Best for a narrow navigation menu of icon entries, some with a count badge, whose grips stay hidden until a row is pressed.

label: Image Gallery
description: Sortable image gallery grid with frame. Best for tiles for image files labeled with name, pixel dimensions and size, set in a titled Frame panel.

label: Persisted Order
description: Sortable list persisted to a backend. Best for numbered release tasks whose new order goes to a mock save on each drop, with the old order restored if it fails.
